copy_gaps: seed '20260928' (the bench CLI default) and cellsPerBar 40: §3 L172 names the generator but no seed; its default is 25 cells per bar
Rows note '· 33.6 px rows, L0': not a spec string; the sketch's '· 17.6 px rows, L0' (L451) with §3 L188's 33.6 px and L0 for this pane (see deviations).
Delta bands 50 / 20 / 5 BTC: the §6.1 sketch's values (L464), drawn as written; §6.2 L524 gives the default as 'E18-S06 sets' (no number).

The preview's "Changed: rows." is the sketch's (§6.1 L455): the spec has no wording for a just-opened dialog (copy gap; E18-D05's copy deck). Drawn as written; it reads as rows changed from the recommended Auto (D12 L162) to the boards' manual 10 ticks (L534-535). The board's Notes say so.
Spec gap (not copy): The title row's [x] (CMP-043 close): its place in the Tab cycle is not in §6.1 L489-491 (gap). Boards 08 and 10 draw the same [x]; carry them to the spec owner together.

The pressed cluster segment reads 'Live' in E11-D02 §7.2 (L267; the word is owner question O-E, 'Live' or 'Following'), while §4.1's sketch writes 'auto' (L227): the board keeps 'auto'; the owner settles the word via E11-D03 (O-E, E11-D02 L819).

D7 (L157) and §8.3 L763 mark the forming bar with the cap and the word 'forming' in the legend, but §4.9 L380-382's legend row has no such word and §4.1's sketch (L218) shows none: the legend reads 'FP Bid × Ask · rows 10 ticks · BTC' (kit legend_text). Carry for E18-D05 (to be raised by the orchestrator, not from this offline lane): a legend '· forming' while the newest or cursor bar forms (D7 L157, §8.3 L763 against §4.9 L380-382); the boards draw it once settled.
live_checks: HOLD: do not render this frame live until the 13:35 POC carry on §4.1 L235 is settled on PR #4180 and board 04's grid follows it (deviations): the chart behind the dialog is board 04's base grid, which every SCR-030 board copies (§0 L37-38). Board 04's fix round (gen_04.py) now draws board 20's placements (13:35 with §4.1's five levels, its POC on 64,011.0, in the window 63,975.0-64,014.0): regenerate this frame's chart from board 04's final grid first.
no inst node on this board: every part is an e18kit composition or a registry icon (nothing to verify against a library set)

dialog: estimated 800 x 727 px at (24, 357); after relayout it must stay ≤ 1,376 px tall (viewport − 64, §6.1 L479), its footer unclipped, its left edge on the plot's (x 24, right of the drawing rail), and clear of the legend row (top of the plot, y ≈ 80-104)
z-order: the dialog is the frame's last child and must render above the toolbar, pane and time strip

the CMP-228 tile's viewport must show exactly three rows (44 × 190, 61 × 228, 38 × 176) with the 'vah tick' on its top edge and the 'val tick' on its bottom edge (6 × 2 px, the left lane), both whole; 64,013.0 and 64,009.0 stay clipped
the focus ring wraps the checked 'Bid × Ask' radio only (2 px color.focus.ring)

compact wells: the 12 CMP-007 / CMP-009 wells are 24 px tall, the row height (`16` §3 L113): check '10 ticks' and its caret fit the 96 px Rows select and '0.001' its 64 px well; the Numbers row reads '[x] Numbers in cells,' then 'hide below [ 8.5 ] px', the ladder sentence on its own line

pressed controls: [FP], Chart and the cluster's auto each lead with the 16 px `check` glyph in ink before the label, on the selected fill (3 check glyphs); the cluster's third segment is the chevron-right glyph, no '>' text. The wider cluster sits at x 2459.3 (was 2488.7; about 92.7 px wide), 98 px clear of the '13:35' label (E11-D02 §7.2: an 8 px exclusion zone): check nothing overlaps
two short labels '×3 buy' sit right of the 13:35 brackets, at each stack's top row (64,007.0 and 64,012.0), inside the plot's free margin (108 px), clear of the price gutter

annotations: estimated 1623 px, the backing and copy column 1156 px and the notes column 916 px; the root hugs (~1655 px): the footer 'SYNTHETIC data · page E18-D02 · board 09 · r1' must end inside the 1,700 px band slot
cell digits: auto-width texts at a computed x (JetBrains Mono 0.6 em): check each side's digits share a right edge and the × column lines up; ▲ / ▼ must come from JetBrains Mono
rename frame 'SCR-032∕default' to 'SCR-032/default' after the board's last section (Penpot shows 'SCR-032 / default')
root: after the first section the root must read back exactly as the sheet's board.name
deviations: The base scene's 40 rows span 63,974.0-64,013.0: the top row is the forming bar's high as §4.1 draws it (L219-220, the cap above 64,013.0); §3 L192-194 fixes 40 rows of 1.0 USDT but no prices.

Candle bodies of generator bars are bars.mjs's open and close (same seed) scaled into the 40-row window; every bar spans the window (§3 L193: every row traded), so the wick runs top to bottom; the body is filled (its form is E12-D06's, §4.1 D3).
Every control, chip, button, field, menu, tooltip, drawer and dialog is a composition named '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)': the wireframes are greys only and cvsheet v1 cannot recolour an instance.
A focus ring is a 2 px color.focus.ring stroke on a wrapper with 4 px padding, 2 px off the control (CMP-039); the wrapper adds 4 px each side to the layout.

Kit geometry for marks the spec sizes only in part: POC rails 1 px on the level's top and bottom edges across the candle strip and the cells; VA ticks 2 px thick (6 px long, D6) at VAH's top edge and VAL's bottom edge; bracket end ticks as thick as the bracket; the cap spans the cells; folded columns draw brackets and VA ticks over the cells' outer edge (D4).
An imbalance outline is two rects: a 1.5 px ink frame (§4.4 L282: a token stroke is 1 or 2 px) and an inner rect in the cell's background; the digits draw over both.
D6's 'bold digits' at the POC are not drawn: no bold mono type token exists at 10 / 11 px (type.num.xs / .sm are regular); the rails carry the POC on the boards (hi-fi: E18-D03).
A stack's zone state is server-told (GAP-18, §4.4 L288-289); the kit draws 'active' (3 px) unless the board names another state.
The preview tile draws the §6.1 sketch's three rows and marks (outlines, the POC rail, the bracket and ×3 buy) and the VA ticks; the bar is the §4.1 anatomy's 13:35 column at the pane's density.
A mark beyond the plot (the forming cap 1 px + 2 px above a column whose top is the window's top, an unfinished-auction ledge at the window's edge) is not drawn: §3's 40 rows fill the pane exactly.
The legend row and the corner badge sit on a raised fill so they read over the cells.

Price labels sit at E11-D02 §5's density gap (40 / 48 / 32 px) on whole-price steps; a label wider than §3's 48 / 56 px gutter floor (L177) extends left into the plot's free margin (memo §3.0: the bar counts are upper bounds).

Frames are named as §0 names them ('SCR-030/fp-anatomy'), and cvsheet splits section paths on '/', so frame() names the node with U+2215 '∕' for '/' while sections address inside it; the live renderer renames each frame to its §0 name after the board's last section (live check).

Dialog position: §6.1 L479-481 fixes 'over the left of the chart panel' and 'at most the viewport height − 64 px' but no offset; the board puts its left edge on the plot's, after the 24 px drawing rail (x 24), as boards 07, 41-48 and 53 anchor the compact dialog, and centres it vertically (CMP-043 convention). At this size the dialog keeps its natural height (under the 1,376 px bound): nothing scrolls.
No scrim or backdrop behind the modal: §6.1 names none and the chart must stay legible beside the dialog while settings apply live (L479-481); CMP-043's tokens list none (`15` L445).

CMP-043 lists color.surface.overlay (`15` L445) and CMP-228 color.surface.sunken (`15` L2668); the kit's dialog binds color.surface.raised and its tile color.surface.app, two of its greys (build notes: greys only); hi-fi is E18-D03's.

The Rows note reads '· 33.6 px rows, L0': the §6.1 sketch's form (L451, '· 17.6 px rows, L0', the 1280 × 800 compact pane) filled with this pane's worked numbers from §3 L188 (2560 × 1440 compact: 33.6 px, L0); the note previews the resulting cell height (`14` SCR-032 checklist, §12 L834).

The CMP-228 tile is drawn at the pane's density, compact (§6.7 L644-645; board 11's compact tile): e18kit sizes its rows by density (17.6 px), not by this pane's 33.6 px rows; the tile is 240 × 200 at every resolution (§0 L53). It adds D6's VA ticks (L156) to the kit's marks, as boards 10 and 11 do: Value area (70 %) is on (§6.1 L461; §6.2 L521) and CMP-228 shows 'the effect of the current settings' (`15` L2665); it is named 'CMP-228 PreviewTile (composition)' as on boards 10 and 11 (`15` L2663). gen_09's kit_tile() (gen_10's and gen_11's helper): the kit's PREVIEW_MARKS lacks 'va' and its default name is 'CMP-228 preview tile (composition)'.

Field wells at the compact control height: every CMP-007 / CMP-009 well (the ten fields, the Rows select and the two side-colour selects) is 24 px tall, `16` §3 L113's compact field height, so each is a 24 × 24 px target or larger (§6.1 L496). gen_09.py lift_wells(): the kit's field() and swatch_select() draw d.row − 4 = 20 px (e18kit.py not edited).

The three standalone checkboxes (Outline imbalanced cells, Bracket stacks (×N label), B / A letters in cells) are named 'CMP-005 Checkbox (composition) · <label>', as the kit names its other checkboxes (build notes: '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)'); the kit names them 'checkbox · outline', '· bracket' and '· letters' (gen_09.py name_checkboxes(); e18kit.py not edited).

D10's two controls (L160; §6.2 L511-512: textLod and lodTextThresholdPx): the CMP-005 checkbox reads 'Numbers in cells,' and the CMP-007 field carries its own label 'hide below' before its well, both verbatim from the sketch (L452). gen_09.py split_numbers() (gen_10's helper): the kit's checkbox label carries both words (COPY numbers.label, no longer drawn as one string), which left the field without a label layer.

Pressed states carry a CMP-019 `check` glyph (size.icon, ink) before the label, the selected fill kept as reinforcement: [FP] (the glyph stands for the sketch's '*', §4.1 L215), Chart (E11-D04 D1 L114, L139: E11-D02 D8's selected fill + check glyph) and the cluster's auto (E11-D02 D8 L115, §7.2 L267: the glyph is the ≥ 3:1 state carrier, the fill decorative, L493-495); §8.3 L771 asks a geometry or text carrier for every state. The kit's ctl() and time_strip() draw the fill alone, so gen_09 adds the glyph (gen_10's press_marks(); e18kit.py not edited). Not drawn: E11-D04's color.border.strong reinforcement edge (not a wireframe grey) and the options' own glyphs icon/chart-candles and icon/table (registry request CR-D04-3; the words carry the options).

The cluster's third segment is E11-D02's `›` (D8 L115; §7.2 L267, named "Latest" in its name and tooltip; at compact the glyph alone, the visible word only at comfortable, E11-D02 L731), drawn as the CMP-019 chevron-right glyph; §4.1's ASCII sketch writes it '>' (L227). The nodes keep their names ('segment · >', 'cluster auto | fit | >') so the section paths hold.

13:35's POC rail is at 63,998.0, not the sketch's 64,011.0 (§4.1 L222's ═ rails): the forming bar trades all 40 rows here (§3 L193) and `24` §4.5 picks the row with the most volume (163 + 163 = 326 BTC against 64,011.0's 61 + 228 = 289). §4.7 L329 / L349 and §8.1 L731 call 64,011.0 the 13:35 POC, true of the five-row column (the kit's anatomy_scene, which this frame's CMP-228 tile draws); 64,011.0 stays inside 13:35's 40-row value area (63,985.0–64,012.0). PENDING CARRY (PR #4180; to be raised by the orchestrator, not from this offline lane), before this frame is drawn live (every SCR-030 board copies this column, §0 L37-38): either (a) §4.1 L235 adds 'On the 40-row base boards the forming 13:35 bar's POC follows `24` §4.5 over its 40 rows (63,998.0); §4.7 L329/L349 and §8.1 L731 read the five-row column', or (b) §4.1 hand-picks 13:35's other base-board rows below 289 BTC so 64,011.0 stays the POC (4 rows reach 289 here: 63,975.0 312, 63,987.0 310, 63,998.0 326, 64,008.0 324). Board 04 (whose grid this frame copies) settles it first; this frame follows.

Two cells read '…' (13:25 and 13:30 at 64,009.0): §4.1 L224 elides them; the kit's anatomy overlay keeps the elision although the generator has values there, because those values (13:25 118 × 79, 13:30 36 × 26) would flag the 64,010.0 ask above them (702 / 118 = 5.95, 201 / 36 = 5.58), outlines the sketch rows do not draw (L220-224). PENDING CARRY (PR #4180; to be raised by the orchestrator, not from this offline lane): §4.1 L224 hand-picks the two cells so the sketch rows gain no outline (13:25: bid 235–2,105, ask ≤ 185; 13:30: bid 68–602, ask ≤ 557; an ask ≥ 21 / ≥ 63 also keeps the 40-row boards' 64,008.0 bid unflagged), then the boards draw those values.

Edge levels (no neighbour inside the bar) are not compared, as §4.1 draws its column (L233 'three outlined cells'; the sketch outlines no edge, L220-224). `24` §4.2 (L792) treats a neighbour outside the traded range as zero volume under zero_policy treat_as_min, a fixed default (spec §6.2 L535-537): all 40 edge sides here are non-zero (20 highs' bids, 20 lows' asks), so `24` would add 40 outlines (308, not 268) and 12:30 gains a ×3 sell stack 64,011.0–64,013.9. PENDING CARRY (PR #4180; to be raised by the orchestrator, not from this offline lane): either an A-row to `24` §4.2 'edge levels are not compared' (what the boards draw), or the boards draw the 40 edge outlines and §4.1 L233's count is corrected.

Forming carrier: none on this frame. D7 (L157) and §8.3 L763 mark the forming bar with the cap and the word 'forming' in the legend; the cap clips at the plot's top (13:35's high is the window's top row: §3's 40 rows fill the 1,344 px pane; §4.5 L307 allows the clip) and §4.9 L380-382's legend row has no 'forming' (copy gap, carry for E18-D05). The status row's 'bar close 0:41' (CMP-226, §4.6 L314) says a bar is forming, not which column. Boards 21 and 28 draw the cap (§0 L63, L70; §5 L398).

The §6.1 sketch runs Markers, Colour and noise and Data source under the end of the preview column (L460-473); e18kit's scr032() keeps the two columns to the footer (D9 L159; the preview column is sticky, L480), so those rows wrap inside the 496 px controls column.

Two more 400 px annotation columns: 'annotations · backing and copy' holds §6.2's 24 control rows (L502: each board annotates every control), set in type.ui.caption as §6.2 writes them, and the Copy keys block; 'annotations · notes' holds the notes. With §0's blocks they do not fit one 400 px column under the 1,700 px band slot (gen_09.py backing_column(), notes_column(), main_blocks(); the board is 3,840 px wide in its 4,600 px band slot).
